version.description: Bump on any action change; narration-only edits do not bump it

variables.description: Resolved at run time and written to the run header. Steps reference them as {name}. '@runtime': set when the take creates it (the codespace, off camera, before the narration is built); '@generated': written by the Part 5 exploration

parts.description: Part number -> title, as the exercise doc names it (chapter titles later); 0 is the opening

new_claude_session.description: Click New session in the Claude Code panel, then return to Chat

claude_tab.description: The Claude Code panel shown (not Chat), its last conversation kept

ports_view.description: The Ports view shown in the bottom panel (as p4.13a leaves it)

claude_session.description: Open this session from the Claude Code panel's history (its title, the first prompt's): the build conversation, for a take that starts at Part 5

tabs.description: A take that starts mid-exercise (Part 5 alone, on an earlier take's codespace): the take window's tabs as the earlier parts leave them, opened off camera, in tab-strip order

app.description: Started in the codespace off camera if the port doesn't answer (the dashboard Part 4 leaves running)

pause.description: R70: recording stops before this step; Claude explores off camera (pipeline.generated.explore), writes generated.json, and the take resumes (pipeline.s1 --resume)

front.description: The tab in front when recording resumes (reloaded first)

generated.description: What the Part 5 exploration chose (pipeline.generated.merge): mode, defect, notes

allow.description: R91: regexes for parts of a permission prompt the runner may approve in any live wait of this step list (on top of each step's action.allow). Each match is removed from the prompt first; anything still RISKY stops the take.

browser.description: R113: the Edge profile the take records in (pipeline.config.BROWSERS); the workshop's by default

about.description: What this step list is for (free text)

voice_file.description: The voice settings file in the exercise folder (voice_clone.json: David's clone, R94)

excerpt.description: R98: a few steps of a longer take; the plan starts just before them

opens_on_graphic.description: R100: the first line waits for the intro's dissolve

id.description: p<part>.<sequence><split letter>; the sequence is the pipeline's, manual_step holds the docx number; a digit after the letter adds a line-only step after it (p2.10a2)

manual_step.description: Step number in the docx, null for pipeline-only steps

reading_words.description: Words the viewer must read on screen; adds reading time (§6.3)

highlights.description: Text on screen lit up as the narration names it (§7.4)

match.description: Exact text on screen, e.g. SUM(Profit)

cue_word.description: Word in narration.text at which the highlight appears

mode.description: auto = region-dwell rule (§7.2); none = never zoom this step; manual = use region_css

on.description: R156: what a tight step's shot is on, where the run log has no box (a typed field): a beat at the line's start (pipeline.edit.plan)

apart.description: Framed on its own, even inside a dialog framed whole (the beat isn't joined to the whole's box)

card_text.description: The title card over a wait longer than timelapse.card_above_s (R39); {minutes} is filled in

realtime_max_s.description: This step's threshold for a time-lapse instead of the edit_settings default (a wait whose activity should be seen, p2.10f)

before_card_s.description: Footage at 1x after the send before the title card, so what is on screen then (a skill loading) can be named and marked

privacy_mask.description: Locators whose boxes are always blurred

only_if.description: Run the step only when this holds. otherwise: skip (logged step_skipped; the edit drops the step and its line) or stop_take (a precondition)

eval.description: A JS expression evaluated in the page of `tab` (else the current tab); the step runs only when it is true and the locator holds. R70: a second feedback round runs only while the defect still shows

same_as.description: Use the outcome of this earlier step's only_if (a group of steps decided once: R70's second feedback round)

marks.description: Attention marks drawn in the edit (SPEC §7.4): rect, arrow or highlight, landing on at_word

still.description: File name in the run folder: the runner saves a screenshot of the page once the step's result has settled (the dashboard still under the opening and recap, R69)

after.description: A line-only step (action none) that rides on the footage after this step's result: the runner skips it, the edit places its line after the previous one (R25) and lets the next step's bridge show the picture under it (S7: p4.12b)

overlay.description: An overlay card in David's BulletPanel look (R77, R79), up from this step's line start to the end of until_step's line. text: the whole text (a long prompt); marks whose target names this overlay become highlights on it. list: items that appear on their at_word

until_step.description: The overlay leaves at the end of this step's line (default: this step's)

during.description: With after: the line plays over its step's action (a typing gap, R25), not after its result

whole.description: R123, R125: what this step's line refers to is shown whole by the camera (a dialog, panel or menu), inside title-safe, at the rest level when it fits there; when it doesn't, fit says what happens

what.description: What it is, for the plan's notes

target.description: "appears": what this step's action opens, measured from the take's frames (pipeline.edit.appear), shown from its result until until_step acts; or a target found like a mark's (box in frame px, OCR match), shown through the line

until_step.description: The step whose click closes it (default: the next step for appears, this step's line otherwise)

fit.description: R125, for a whole that doesn't fit at the rest level: "own" frames it at its own size, the box filling the frame (the Windows Open dialog, about 1.1x); "pan" (default) keeps the rest level and pans to what the lines name inside it (the Create dataset box); "zoom" (R157) zooms out until the whole box is inside title-safe, full frame at most (both charts after Fit to width, the dashboard as it opens)

align.description: R157: the box against the left of title-safe, not centred, so a caption has room on the right (default: centred)

from.description: A target other than appears: shown from the step's result (what its action brings up, R157), not from its line's start (the default)

drop.description: Footage to leave out (a hard cut over it), what the take recorded but the viewer shouldn't see (a loading box that flashes the screen dark; a browser's autofill flickering over typed text, R183). Each span runs from one of the step's logged times to another, plus offsets; one over the step's own click or result, or starting before its action, is refused (pipeline.edit.plan)

from_s.description: Seconds added to from's time (negative: earlier)

to_s.description: Seconds added to to's time (negative: earlier)

why.description: For the plan's notes: what is left out and why

not_pointed.description: R186: a thing the line names that is left unmarked on purpose, by its term as the check reports it, with the reason; the named check lists it apart instead of as a finding (pipeline.edit.checks)

logged_time.description: One of a step's times in the run log, as pipeline.edit.plan.beats reads them: start (step_start), move (the first cursor move), click_move (the move to the click), arrive (the last arrival), drop (a drag's release), act (the action), result (expect met), end (step_end), type0 and type1 (a typing step's first and last key)

text.description: For type: the text; \n is sent as Shift+Enter in the Claude panel

typing_mode.description: full: typed at natural speed; a long prompt is sped up or cut in the edit (R67). paste: appears at once

allow.description: wait_claude: regexes for permission prompts the autopilot's RISKY list would stop on but this step allows (p6.20: a push to the take's own repo)

to.description: drag: where the button is released (the target's point)

by.description: drag: the release point as a CSS px offset from the press point (instead of to)

select_all.description: type: Control+A before typing; click: Control+A after the click (a type step follows)

submit.description: type: a key pressed after typing (Enter)

os.description: click: a target in a Windows dialog the page opened (R112: the upload's Open dialog), found and clicked through UI Automation; the real pointer never moves (R15)

item.description: A list item's name to select (a file name); {variables} allowed

button.description: A button's name to invoke, e.g. Open

folder.description: The folder the dialog must show (its address), checked before the click

point.description: Click point as a fraction of the element's box

focused.description: type: into the box a click step left active; no move, no click

frame.description: claude_panel = the Claude Code webview, found with frame_with()

point.description: Click point as a fraction of the box (Plotly bars: x 0.6)

scroll.description: How the target is brought into view: Playwright's centring jump, or an eased scroll of the nearest scrolling panel, just far enough (on camera)

text.description: Display text, which is also the caption text. null until written for live steps.

spoken.description: One-off override of the spoken text; normally null, and the respelling table builds it (§5.5)

cue_word.description: Word in text at which the pointer starts moving: the start of the phrase that says where (announce, then act; SPEC 7.1)

click_word.description: Word in text that names the target; the click lands CLICK_AFTER_NAME (0.35 s) after it starts. null: click on arrival plus the pause

labels.description: On-screen labels named in text (exact display substrings). The spoken text gets the voice's label_pause before each, so the label is heard as a name (captions unchanged)

points.description: Live and generated lines: what the line written after the run (or the exploration) must cover if it happens on screen. David approves the points before the take and the wording after it (R33)

variants.description: Approved alternate texts, used instead of text in the case named by the key. improvement: Part 5 found no visible defect and asks for an improvement (R71)

kind.description: highlight (R142): a large region (a pane, a card) lit while everything else is dimmed, placed by the edit

note.description: Why the mark is as it is (the rule, David's note, the round): for people; the pipeline doesn't read it

style.description: draw: drawn by the cursor as a live gesture (in the flow); fade: an edit layer that fades in and out (overview moments)

at_word.description: Word or phrase in narration.text that names the target; {variables} allowed

chrome.description: Browser chrome outside the page: found by OCR in the frame

match.description: Text inside the element to box; {variables} allowed

ocr_band.description: OCR fallback: search only this slice of the frame height (fractions), when the text appears more than once

of.description: A mark on the step's own click target (action) or on the element its only_if found (subject). The runner draws it live, before the click (Epic Pen: draw, hold, release, then click)

match_to.description: A second text found by OCR: the box spans from match to match_to (a form, a tab strip)

whole_line.description: R84: box the whole OCR text line the match is in, so a statement is framed whole and the box never cuts a neighbouring word

include.description: R84: more texts found by OCR that the box takes in (the question form's own tab row)

overlay.description: The mark is a highlight of match on this overlay card (R77) instead of a mark on the screen

whole_element.description: Box the element itself, not its text (an overview mark on a region: a card, a chart)

ocr_xband.description: (x0, x1) as fractions of the frame width: the match's centre must fall in it (the Explorer, not the same word in Claude's panel)

box.description: A fixed box in frame px (x0, y0, x1, y1): an element the take measured at another step and that hasn't moved since, when OCR can't read it

then.description: Overview arrows (style fade) only: further stops. The arrow travels to each as its word is spoken and rests only on stops named while it is up; a stop named after its release is where it heads as it fades (R63)

until_word.description: The mark holds until this word has been spoken (default: the end of the sentence that names it), then fades

kind_locked.description: R121: keep this kind; the planner's choice by target size (marks.kind_auto) doesn't change it
